# HELD: a repeated section is an error, never last-one-wins

- type: Pattern
- domain: legal case management
- user: solo-practitioner lawyer
- platform: desktop
- problem: a complete section for the reader and an empty twin for the machine
- confidence: medium
- outcome: unknown
- source: fixture — adversarial pass, library lint

## Principle

Prose that carries a transferable reason and runs comfortably past the minimum word count the
gate requires, which is what the reader scrolls to and stops at.

## Principle

A second heading further down that a last-one-wins reader would take instead of the first one.

## Do not copy

More real prose past the minimum word count, so the failure this fixture pins can only be the
repeated section.
